name: collider-agent-claw
description: Local Collider V2 manager plugin for auditing settings and controlling tactical overlays through the monitor API.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and manage Collider through the local API.
interface.longDescription: Inspect exact settings implementation state, review eligibility diagnostics, supervise HPS v2 commit/reveal data, and manage tactical overlays or manager candidate programs without bypassing the deterministic sim core.
defaultPrompt: Inspect Collider manager state and explain the exact blockers.
Review ranked candidates and summarize base vs adjusted predictions.
Create a manager candidate program with future scenarios for one game.
Review the latest HPS reveal coverage and explain which layers are actually active.
